Title: Orlando Oriandus and Temporary Additional Votes

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Does Orlando Oriandus double temporary additional votes on vampires you control?

Examples:

Census Taker
Type: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Unique master.
Put this card on a ready Black Hand vampire. During an action, this Black Hand vampire can tap to give any other Sabbat vampire +1 bleed or 2 additional votes for the current action. During an action, this Black Hand vampire can tap to give any other Black Hand vampire +1 intercept.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Dorrinal
Messages.Body: Yes. Orlando multiplies all votes that come from a vampire (as opposed to, say, Ventrue Headquarters). See also: Mob Rule.

Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Juggernaut1981 wrote:
> Does Orlando Oriandus double temporary additional votes on vampires you control?
>
"Temporary" isn't a term used.
Does Orlando double the votes your vampires have until the end of the action? Yes, because they're votes your vampires have.
